title: GameLevelPlan
responsibility: Guide concept, brief, generation and human approval before building a level.

inputs.name: GameLevelPlan.context
inputs.description: The level being planned (`view`), the whole `document` that each generation request sends, and the `readonly` flag, which blocks generating, editing, approving and building. `projectId`, `revision`, `commit` and `bridge` are optional: generating needs `projectId`, `revision` and `bridge.gameLevelGenerate`, a set `commit` (history) blocks it, and the component passes the reason to the steps as `status.reason`.

inputs.name: GameLevelPlan.run
inputs.description: The preview run, which only `build()` reads and replaces through the `run` binding: it sets `state.x` and `state.y` to the layout's `spawn.x` and `spawn.z`, removes this view's `trace` entries, empties `completed` entirely and resets this view's `progress` to an empty list. Every other field of the run and of `state` is kept as it is.

inputs.name: GameLevelPlan.change
inputs.description: The callback that receives each edit as a partial view patch: `{ dimension, planning }` for any brief, dimension or proposal change or withdrawal (these clear `planning.approved` and `planning.built`), `{ planning }` with `planning.approved` set to the proposal id for an approval, and `{ world, planning }` with `planning.built` set to the proposal id for a build, where `world` is a `$state.snapshot` of the proposal layout. It is never called while `readonly` is true.

outputs.name: GameLevelPlan
outputs.description: The `hx-section` for the level plan: a heading from the current step (`What is this level?`, `Describe the level`, `Review the proposal` or `Level built`) with a `Step n of 3` label on every step but the built one, then `GameLevelBrief` on the concept and brief steps or `GameLevelReview` on the other steps once a proposal exists. A review or built step without a proposal shows only the heading.
